get.description:
List Change Order Packages.

See [Filtering on List Actions](https://developers.procore.com/documentation/filtering-on-list-actions) for information on using the filtering capabilities provided by this endpoint.

parameters.name: contract_id
parameters.description: ID of the contract to scope change order packages to (a Prime, Purchase Order, or Work Order Contract).

parameters.name: filters[id]
parameters.description: Return item(s) with the specified IDs.

parameters.name: filters[created_at]
parameters.description:
Return item(s) created within the specified ISO 8601 datetime range.
Formats:
`YYYY-MM-DD`...`YYYY-MM-DD` - Date
`YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SSZ`...`YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SSZ` - DateTime with UTC Offset
`YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SS+XX:00...`YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SS+XX:00` - Datetime with Custom Offset

parameters.name: filters[updated_at]
parameters.description:
Return item(s) last updated within the specified ISO 8601 datetime range.
Formats:
`YYYY-MM-DD`...`YYYY-MM-DD` - Date
`YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SSZ`...`YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SSZ` - DateTime with UTC Offset
`YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SS+XX:00`...`YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SS+XX:00` - Datetime with Custom Offset

parameters.name: filters[reviewed_at]
parameters.description: Returns item(s) reviewed within the specified ISO 8601 datetime range.

parameters.name: filters[due_date]
parameters.description: Returns item(s) due within the specified ISO 8601 datetime range.

parameters.name: filters[include_deleted]
parameters.description: Use 'only' for only deleted resources. Use 'with' for deleted and undeleted resources.

parameters.name: filters[invoiced_date]
parameters.description: Returns item(s) invoiced within the specified ISO 8601 datetime range.

parameters.name: filters[paid_date]
parameters.description: Returns item(s) paid within the specified ISO 8601 datetime range.

parameters.name: filters[signed_change_order_received_date]
parameters.description: Return item(s) with a signed change order received date within the specified ISO 8601 date range.

import http.client

conn = http.client.HTTPSConnection("api.procore.com")

headers = { 'Authorization': "Bearer REPLACE_BEARER_TOKEN" }

conn.request("GET", "/rest/v1.0/change_order_packages?project_id=SOME_INTEGER_VALUE&contract_id=SOME_INTEGER_VALUE&filters%5Bid%5D=SOME_ARRAY_VALUE&filters%5Bcreated_at%5D=SOME_STRING_VALUE&filters%5Bupdated_at%5D=SOME_STRING_VALUE&filters%5Breviewed_at%5D=SOME_STRING_VALUE&filters%5Bdue_date%5D=SOME_STRING_VALUE&filters%5Binclude_deleted%5D=SOME_STRING_VALUE&filters%5Binvoiced_date%5D=SOME_STRING_VALUE&filters%5Bpaid_date%5D=SOME_STRING_VALUE&filters%5Bsigned_change_order_received_date%5D=SOME_STRING_VALUE&page=SOME_INTEGER_VALUE&per_page=SOME_INTEGER_VALUE", headers=headers)

res = conn.getresponse()
data = res.read()

print(data.decode("utf-8"))

import http.client

conn = http.client.HTTPSConnection("api.procore.com")

payload = "{\"project_id\":345357,\"contract_id\":64545,\"change_order\":{\"status\":\"draft\",\"title\":\"Additional Time & Materials\",\"description\":\"Additional Time & Materials for October\",\"schedule_impact_amount\":5,\"origin_code\":\"ABC-123\",\"origin_data\":\"OD-123654789\",\"origin_id\":\"654987123\",\"paid_date\":\"2016-10-22\",\"invoiced_date\":\"2016-10-26\",\"due_date\":\"2016-10-23\",\"executed\":true,\"signed_change_order_received_date\":\"2016-10-23\"}}"

headers = {
    'Authorization': "Bearer REPLACE_BEARER_TOKEN",
    'content-type': "application/json"
    }

conn.request("PATCH", "/rest/v1.0/change_order_packages/%7Bid%7D", payload, headers)

res = conn.getresponse()
data = res.read()

print(data.decode("utf-8"))
